queue.assessment: Healthy but idle. With QUEUE_CONNECTION=database, queue depth is only drained when a worker is running; a stopped worker silently accumulates jobs.

findings.title: Laravel's demo 'inspire' command is still scheduled hourly
findings.impact: Harmless but it is framework demo scaffolding running in production, and it is evidence that the schedule is not curated.
findings.why_not_applied: It changes registered schedule entries, which the brief treats as protected scheduler behaviour.

findings.title: bookings:expire-pending runs every 5 minutes with no overlap guard
findings.impact: If a run exceeds 5 minutes, two instances can overlap and both transition the same pending bookings.

findings.title: No monitoring or alerting on scheduler success/failure
findings.impact: A command that starts failing every night (for example currency:sync-rates after a gateway failure) is silent.

findings.title: No queue worker supervision documented
findings.impact: database queue without a supervised worker is a common silent-failure mode.

lesson_reaffirmed: Three business-critical commands have zero import references. Any future dead-code analysis MUST include runtime registration, not just reference counts.
